datasheet.title: Schneider Electric APC NetShelter Metered Rack PDU AP7821B product datasheet (5 Nov 2026 copy)

description: APC by Schneider Electric NetShelter metered rack PDU, 1U horizontal: a 444 mm black metal box, 102 mm deep. It hands a 200 to 230 V feed (a C20 inlet; 16 A rated, 3300 VA) on to eight IEC C13 outlets in one row. It has no breaker and no switching. The outlet face has the inlet at the left end. At the right end it has a two-digit display, a round button, two jacks and three small lamps. The other face is plain, with a logo and a ground mark. A cord retention bracket and rack mounting brackets are supplied.

gaps.note: the datasheet says "Mounting location Front Rear" and names no face as the front. The face with the outlets is drawn as `rear` and the plain face as `front`, the usual way a horizontal PDU is racked; no held document says so.
every position on the outlet face is borrowed from a reading of the AP7921B's photograph and is an estimate good to a few millimetres; none is measured on this model.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing or a straight-on photograph of this model with a scale.

gaps.note: the datasheet sells the unit as metered and says nothing of what is metered or where; the display is one window, so the input is the scope drawn.
gaps.wanted: the user manual's description of the metering.

gaps.note: small lamps stand over the display and beside the jacks, some lit green or amber in the photographs; their count, colours and meanings were not read off the pixels and no document names them, so three are drawn unlit and uncoloured.
gaps.wanted: the user manual's description of the status lamps.

gaps.note: the labels under the two jacks are not legible and no datasheet names a port.
gaps.wanted: the user manual, or a close photograph of the jacks.

name: ap7821b

capability.note: datasheet - sold as a metered rack PDU (title, p.1). What it meters is not stated; `metering-scope: input` is the scope the single display could carry and is a stand-in until a source says (gaps: metering-scope). The unit has no switching in any held document: `outlet-switching: false`.

chassis.note: datasheet - AP7821B datasheet: Height 44 mm, Width 444 mm, Depth 102 mm, net weight 1.74 kg (p.1); 1U. Colour read off the p.5 photographs at the median of the face, #33323a, estimated as black matte; no document names one. The drawn colour, #2c2e30, is the library's black-matte estimate for the sibling AP7921B (whose face reads #272d2d in another photograph) and is not taken from this photograph; the lighter reading is lighting.

dcim.note: datasheet - the input is a C20 power port (`iec-60320-c20`) and each outlet an `iec-60320-c13` power outlet fed by it. The outlets are named as the unit prints them, 1 to 8.

display.note: estimated - apc/ap78-display@1. The datasheet's text names no display; the photograph shows the window.

ears.note: NOT DRAWN. The datasheet lists rack mounting brackets and a cord retention bracket as supplied (p.1) and states "Mounting location Front Rear", "Mounting position Horizontal". No document says where the brackets bolt, so one `flush` position is written without a figure and it is a stand-in (gaps: ears).

front.note: estimated - the plain face, read off the datasheet's p.5 photograph (near front-on, the better of the two views of it): a small round hole near the left end with an earth mark under it, the APC logo with its web address at the right end and a small label under it reading "Metered Rack PDU" in part, the rest not legible. Positions read off the photograph, good to about 3 mm. Which face is the rack front is not stated (gaps: face-names).

input.note: datasheet - "Input Connection Type IEC 60320 C20", input 200 V 208 V 230 V, output 208 V 230 V, 50/60 Hz, input current limit 20 A, rated current 16 A, max current draw 20 A, load capacity 3300 VA, cable 2.4 m (p.1). The datasheet lists no cord among what is provided, so none is drawn and none is stated.

jacks.note: estimated - two jacks shaped like RJ45 jacks at the right end (p.5 photograph); their labels are not legible and no document names them, so each is std/rj45@2, without a role.

method.note: NO DRAWING EXISTS AND THE ONLY PICTURES ARE 369 PX DATASHEET PHOTOGRAPHS, so every position is an estimate. Searched: the APC AP7821B datasheet (6 pp), the Schneider Electric release notes for the network card (990-6391K, no figure of a PDU) and the intake's coverage report; none dimensions a face, and no installation guide, drawing, stencil or CAD file is held. The datasheet's p.5 outlet-face photograph is taken at an angle, so no pitch can be measured on it. The datasheet's p.1 photograph of this model's outlet face is near front-on, but it was used only to check order and the pitch roughly, not to re-read each position. The positions here are the ones read off the AP7921B's near-front-on photograph (see apc/ap7921b), checked against this model's photographs for order: inlet, eight outlets, display, button, two jacks, logo. THE POSITIONS ARE BORROWED, NOT MEASURED ON THIS MODEL (gaps: face-positions); a re-reading of the right-hand end on the p.1 photograph is still to do.

outlets.note: datasheet - "Number of power socket outlets 8 IEC 60320 C13" (p.1); each is std/c13-outlet@1. "Protection type Without circuit breaker" (p.1). No per-outlet rating and no bank is stated.

rear.note: estimated - the outlet face, mm from the face's left and top, borrowed from the AP7921B photograph reading (see `method`): the inlet's centre at 17, eight outlets from 55 on a 36.1 pitch, numbered 1 to 8 under their mouths as printed, the display's window from 333 to 355 across, the round button centred at 376, two jacks centred at 397, the logo right of them, and three small lamps. The inlet is empty in this photograph.
